implementation.name: original-v2-carbon-aware-scheduling
implementation.scope: Source feasible time shift plus explicit alternative capacity/deadline comparisons; qualitative overhead conditions.
implementation.question: When is waiting for a lower-carbon window actually useful?

purpose: Show checkpoint-enabled waiting, constraint-gated admission, job completion, and separate conditional net-carbon judgment.
storyboard: Create a checkpoint and wait without useful training running.
Check capacity and complete-run deadline feasibility.
Admit only the feasible case; comparison cases remain blocked.
Execute then finish the admitted job.
Compare chosen overhead relation against avoided emissions; default remains unquantified.
guard: No numerical emissions or measured forecast; job duration unchanged; sourcecase finisheswithslack; comparisons explicit; no admission without headroom/deadline; net saving only conditional.
